A memorable Vietnamese food experience
Oct 2026 • Couples
As a visitor to Ho Chi Minh City, I wanted to try authentic Vietnamese cuisine beyond the usual tourist recommendations. A Taste Of Saigon - Kitchen turned out to be a wonderful discovery. The fresh spring rolls were light and refreshing, while the fried spring rolls with duck had a lovely crispy texture. I also tried the crab soup with corn and quail eggs, which was comforting and flavorful. The menu offered a nice variety of traditional dishes, making it easy to explore Vietnamese food in one place. I left feeling satisfied and happy with my choice.

A great place to catch up with friends
Oct 2026 • Friends
I met a few friends here for lunch, and we had such a good time. We ordered several dishes to share, including the fresh spring rolls with pork and shrimp, fried squid rings, and shaken shrimp with garlic butter. Everything tasted fresh and was nicely prepared. I particularly enjoyed the combination of traditional Vietnamese flavors with a presentation that felt approachable and inviting. Sharing different dishes made the meal even more enjoyable. Definitely a place I would recommend for a relaxed get-together with friends.
